text:
zoe: FYI onboarding atlas-30b-int4 on dedicated-staging. long-doc tests show KV-cache saturation / token duplication after ~48k tokens. short repro below.

arjun: which quant profile? int4-compact or int4-v2-sparse?

zoe: int4-compact with pack-order=v2. repro command:
```
./bin/eval_runner --model atlas-30b-int4 --prompt tests/long/large_headers.txt --max-tokens 70000 --kv-verbose --seed=7
```

perf-bot: canary metrics posted -> latency p50 3.4ms p95 9.2ms, token-error-rate 0.6% (baseline 0.02%)

lina: any logs from the serving runtime showing wrap/phase?

zoe: pasted relevant log fragment:
```
[2026-02-11T09:12:02.341Z] kv_cache: shard=1 write_idx=65534 expected_rot_idx=65535 actual_rot_idx=65533
[2026-02-11T09:12:02.341Z] rotary: computed_phase=32767 stored_phase=32765
[2026-02-11T09:12:02.341Z] token_check: duplicate_token_detected token_id=50123 at pos=48321
```

arjun: looks like a double-step underflow when the packing crosses 65536 boundary. pack-order=v2 changed lane interleaving vs v1, kernel assumes contiguous lane offsets.

zoe: tried setting KV_STRIDE_FIX=1 and run with --kv-offset-shift=2. reduces duplicates but introduces missing-context tail in some runs. quick example test:
```
# stress harness
for n in range(0,10):
  ctx = Prelude.repeat(header, repeats=6000)
  out = model.generate(ctx, max_new_tokens=512)
  check_integrity(out)
```

devops: deploy-bot: canary deploy atlas-30b-int4 -> staging-pool-7 at 2026-02-11T09:15:00Z

arjun: I'll bisect the packing kernel and the roperot2 convo code. suspect commit 0a3f2b8 changed rotate_index arithmetic to use int32 truncation on packed lanes. assigning to @arjun to run kernel rollback tests.

lina: suggest also trying ROPE_MOD=mod65536 vs mod32768 toggles in the runtime, to see if scaling mismatch is mod-related. can you try quick A/B?

zoe: did A/B: ROPE_MOD=32768 removes double-step but breaks longer runs >60k (wrap earlier). numbers: duplicates -> 0.1% with 65536 default, 0.0% with 32768 but higher PPL overall. uploading traces and seed list to s3://redwood-evals/atlas30b/int4-longprefill/2026-02-11/trace-1764141414.tar.gz

arjun: thanks. next steps: bisect kernel, try pack-order=v1 fallback, and add an integration test that primes >70k tokens to catch wrap boundary. I'll add a flaky test to tester/longprefill/test_wrap_bounds.py and run overnight.

zoe: adding note: observed that duplicated token ids are always odd numbers and seem correlated with lane shuffle pattern. might be useful clue for bitpacking. :eyes:

perf-bot: alert created #perf-alerts: token-dup-detected atlas-30b-int4 staging (link)

lina: if bisect identifies kernel regression, we should pin int4-compact to pack-order=v1 for now and open rollback ticket.

arjun: agreed. will report findings tomorrow.

zoe: thanks all — keeping logs and short triage in this thread. will post PR/commit ids when available. :thumbsup:
